descriptors.R: nominee of the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since 2015; a businessman and television personality who has never held public office
descriptors.D: nominee of the party that has held the White House since 2009; a former Secretary of State and senator

compile_desc.R: the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since 2015
compile_desc.D: the party that has held the White House since 2009

others_line: Other candidates on most ballots, including a Libertarian and a Green nominee, and an independent conservative on some (answer "other").
never_name: Trump, Clinton, Obama, Pence, Kaine, Biden, Sanders, Cruz, Rubio, Kasich, Bush, Gary Johnson, Weld, Stein, McMullin or Comey

slice_sources.men: 2016 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2016; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2016); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2016 returns.
slice_sources.women: 2016 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2016; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2016); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2016 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 2016 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2016; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2016); calibrated to the certified 2016 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 2016 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2016; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2016), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 2016 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 2016 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2016; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the congressional majority party's nominee's slogan
the nominee of the congressional majority party
